eligibility_evidence: Do you have experience managing on-premises and cloud infrastructure, including hybrid environments and migrations?

Our Systems Administrator will primarily work across Microsoft 365, Azure, Intune and hybrid infrastructure but also assist in supporting our Linux desktop environment, combining hands-on technical administration with project delivery, service improvement and user support.

Maintain hybrid infrastructure: Administer and support on-premises Active Directory and its integration with Microsoft cloud services, alongside Windows servers and infrastructure running on physical and VMware platforms.
Deliver technical projects and migrations: Plan and implement Windows infrastructure projects, including migrations to Microsoft 365, Azure and hybrid or cloud environments.
